entities.name: RlmN
observations: Sequence is 425 aa and matches reviewed RlmN homologs at 45.6–49.7% identity with 78.6–87.8% query coverage.
Curated homologs annotate RlmN as a dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase, EC 2.1.1.192, modifying A2503 of 23S rRNA and A37 of tRNA to m2A.
Homolog annotations report a [4Fe-4S] cluster and exchangeable S-adenosyl-L-methionine; assignment for this query is inferred from homology.

entities.name: RlmN RNA methylation
observations: Catalytic outcome: adenosine at position 2503 of 23S rRNA or position 37 of tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine; the curated reaction uses two S-adenosyl-L-methionine molecules, producing 5'-deoxyadenosine, L-methionine, and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, with reduced ferredoxin oxidized.
